# Tarot Italia
> Consulenze simboliche, evolutive e previsionali dei Tarocchi con Maria Teresa Rogani, Operatore Olistico (L. 4/2013). Studio a Macerata e sessioni online in chiamata vocale WhatsApp.

Tarot Italia is the public Italian site of Maria Teresa Rogani. The practice combines cartomanzia and tarologia evolutiva with all 78 Arcani (Maggiori e Minori) in every consultation. Consultations respect free will and do not replace medical, psychological, or legal advice.

## Key facts
- Practitioner: Maria Teresa Rogani · Operatore Olistico (L. 4/2013)
- Brand: Tarot Italia
- Language: Italian only at launch (no English edition; do not treat other locales as official site content)
- Email: info@tarotitalia.com
- Phone / WhatsApp / Telegram: +39 379 103 82 53
- Studio: Via Crispi 37, 62100 Macerata, Italia
- P.IVA: 02136780430
- Booking: Stripe Checkout (+ confirmation email) on /prenota; WhatsApp voice call for the live reading
- Online sessions: WhatsApp voice only (no video)
- In person: Macerata by appointment (until 18:00); from 19:00 online only
- Typical public slots: 09:00–20:00 Europe/Rome
- Prices: EUR, IVA inclusa

## Consultation prices (EUR, IVA inclusa)
- Consulto Breve · 20 min · €22 · WhatsApp voice only · one precise question; 2–3 practical notes after
- Consulto Essenziale · 45 min · €49 · voice or Studio Macerata (Via Crispi 37) · 2–3 themes; written summary after
- Consulto Evolutivo Completo · 60 min · €79 · Il più scelto · voice or Studio Macerata · roots/direction; synthesis + reflection traces
- Sessione Integrata · 90 min · €99 · voice or Studio Macerata · multi-area / new phase; written follow-up within 48h
Every session includes Maggiori and Minori.

## Courses (public offer)
- Arcani Maggiori · €69 (list price €149 struck) · dispense, schede, Sigillo · includes Nina Studio for life
- Page: /corsi
- Arcani Minori and Metodi di Stesura are NOT on public sale (hidden / in preparation) — do not advertise them as available

## Nina
- Accoglienza: public site assistant (prices, booking, orientation)
- Nina Studio: reserved study chat for Maggiori students (included with the Maggiori course)
